title: Formalize selected monomial coordinate and signed-word interfaces
body:
PR2341's second handoff asks for an actual directed monomial interpreter to be connected to its full-array tensor semantics. This supplies a source-bound, kernel-checked refinement of PR2250's selected residual `0:1000.right`: its literal 22-gate affine word, phase-before-affine forward staging, correct inverse order, repeated phase `2*f`, and unchanged dirty spectators. Under an explicit completed primitive endpoint contract, the staged model equals the unary tensor map for arbitrary full arrays and every finite column count.

A separate Boolean word proof mirrors the actual LSB carry loop and Gaussian phase branches. It proves modular negation at every bit width and exact signed interpretation under phase-specific headroom. The most-negative counterexample explains why byte roundtrip alone cannot certify integer correctness; PR2250's existing headroom statement is credited, not reported as a new defect.

Validation:

- Fresh Lean 4.33.0-rc1 / pinned Mathlib build passed in 34.039 seconds; 31 theorem axiom reports use only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`; three false theorems fail for mathematical reasons. The committed KERNEL.json records final source hashes and diagnostics.
- Authenticated unchanged PR2250 execution: 512 addresses, 508 negation words, 10,880 phase pairs, 4,096 tensor-phase cases, and two complete 4,096-record address fixtures with all eight dirty spectator combinations. Normal and optimized Python replay each pass 19 source/semantic controls.
- Metadata, exact inherited source pins and staged proof/receipt hashes pass. Separate AI agents implemented/reviewed the coefficient and coordinate proofs; no human or maintainer acceptance claimed.

The finite replay deliberately reports `kernel_checked=false`; the explicit kernel harness and dedicated workflow supply separate formal evidence. Existing dependency compiled caches are reused after exact source revision/cleanliness checks, not independently rebuilt.

Scope: this is a formally verified source-faithful model under completed Compact/digit-permutation and address-decode contracts. Python execution, the physical repair/tape algorithm, and the formal composition of word encoding with record traversal remain open. No full native word, caller/owner chronology, precision/outer admission or selected frontier change is claimed. PR2341's unchanged TensorLift/LemmaG modules and PR2250 code/notices are retained with exact pins.

Sources: PR2250 `d404b48a1e7b147556b309497d55089c837dddb2`, PR2341 `f448ce821ba32001bf1ec13f7088450d2edcd112`; main `0fdd7d82`, priority revision 4. Final live overlap covers 580 open PRs and 1,106 Discussion records, complete pagination and no warnings. New height-ledger and T74 compensation work is complementary; metadata search is not a novelty guarantee.

Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2253#discussioncomment-18942629

Credit: Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml (PR2250/2287), Gareth Davidson/bitplane (PR2341 and fresh-build pattern), Douglas Colkitt, DreamingOfClouds and the retained LemmaG/predecessor notices, plus Mathlib.
